camel_example: aliyun sas BatchUpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigList.1.FieldValue b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --ConfigList.1.Field fileMd5 --ConfigList.1.EventName ALL --ConfigList.1.Source agentless --ConfigList.1.Operator strEqual --ConfigList.1.ConfigId 1 --ConfigList.1.TargetValue ALL --ConfigList.1.TargetType ALL
description_en: Modifies multiple whitelist rules for sensitive file alerts in agentless detection
description_zh: 批量修改无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则
kebab_example: aliyun sas batch-update-malicious-file-whitelist-config --config-list Operator=strEqual Field=fileMd5 TargetValue=ALL TargetType=ALL ConfigId=1 EventName=ALL FieldValue=b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 Source=agentless --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig

fields.help_en: The ID of the whitelist rule for sensitive file alerts in agentless detection. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a new rule is created. You can call the [ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs](~~ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs~~) operation to obtain the ID of the whitelist rule for sensitive files
fields.help_zh: 无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则ID，可选，不传代表新增规则。可调用[ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs](~~ListMaliciousFileWhitelistConfigs~~)获取敏感文件加白规则的ID
fields.name: config_id

fields.help_en:
The alerting name. Valid values:
ALL: all Alarm Metrics
fields.help_zh:
告警名称：
ALL： 全部告警类型
fields.name: event_name

fields.help_en: The field used to determine the whitelist for sensitive file alerts
fields.help_zh: 敏感文件告警中用于加白判定的字段
fields.name: field

fields.help_en: The expected field value to be whitelisted
fields.name: field_value

fields.help_en:
The operator used to evaluate the rule. Valid values:
strEqual: equal to
fields.help_zh:
规则判定操作符：
strEqual：字符串相等
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en:
The business source. Valid values:
agentless: agentless detection
fields.help_zh:
业务来源：
agentless：无代理检测
fields.name: source

fields.help_en:
The type of the target to which the rule applies. Valid values:
ALL: all assets.
SELECTION_KEY: assets selected by using the asset selection component
fields.help_zh:
生效目标类型：
ALL：全部资产
SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
fields.name: target_type

fields.help_en:
The scope of the target to which the rule applies. Valid values:
ALL: all assets.
Other values: the key of the asset scope selected by using the asset selection component
fields.help_zh:
目标生效范围：
ALL：全部资产
其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key
fields.name: target_value

parameters.help_en: The list of whitelist rules for sensitive file alerts in agentless detection
parameters.help_zh: 无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则列表
parameters.name: config_list
